pinterest.title: Getting Married in Hawaii: The Legal Steps for Australian Couples, in Order
pinterest.description: Getting married in Hawaii as an Australian couple is straightforward. Apply online for a marriage licence, meet a licence agent together in person no sooner than 30 days before the ceremony, and marry with a state-licensed officiant within 30 days of picking up the licence. There is no residency requirement, no US citizenship requirement and no blood test. Read the full step-by-step guide.

pinterest.title: Hawaii Marriage Licence Checklist: What to Bring to Your Agent Appointment
pinterest.description: Planning a wedding in Hawaii? You both appear in person to collect the licence, and proxies are not allowed. Bring a valid government-issued photo ID such as a passport for each of you and proof of age. Bring a certified divorce decree or death certificate if it is less than 30 days old, certified translations of any document not in English, and name change papers where relevant. Read the full guide.

pinterest.title: Which Hawaiian Island Suits Your Wedding? Oahu, Maui, Kauai or Hawaii Island
pinterest.description: The Hawaii marriage licence process is the same on every island, but the agent you meet and the flights you book are not. Oahu suits a guest list that wants the simplest arrival into Honolulu. Maui suits a weekend built around one resort. Kauai suits a smaller, quieter wedding framed by green cliffs. Hawaii Island suits a resort wedding on the Kona-Kohala Coast. Read the full guide to getting married in Hawaii.

slides: Getting married in Hawaii? Here is the legal sequence for Australian couples, step by step.
No residency requirement, no US citizenship requirement and no blood test.
Step 1: Complete the online marriage licence application at home, and keep your Authorization Code (Locator ID).
Step 2: Meet a licence agent together, in person, no sooner than 30 days before the ceremony. Proxies are not allowed.
Step 3: Marry with an officiant licensed by the State of Hawaii within 30 days of picking up the licence, or it is void.
Step 4: Order certified copies of your marriage certificate. A certified copy is usually accepted as proof of the marriage in Australia.
Marrying on a public State beach? You need a right-of-entry permit from the Department of Land and Natural Resources.
Picturing Hawaii? Message us to talk it through with a Wedded Advisor, from the island to the guest list. Link in bio.
instagram_carousel.caption:
Getting married in Hawaii as an Australian couple is straightforward, once you know the order of things.

1. Apply online for a marriage licence and keep your Authorization Code, also called the Locator ID.
2. Meet a licence agent together, in person, no sooner than 30 days before the ceremony. Bring a government-issued photo ID such as a passport for each of you, and proof of age.
3. Marry with a state-licensed officiant within 30 days of picking up the licence. The licence is valid only in the State of Hawaii.
4. Order certified copies of your marriage certificate. Processing usually takes up to four to six weeks, so order more than one.

There is no residency requirement, no US citizenship requirement and no blood test.

Want a friend from Australia to marry you? They need a State of Hawaii performer licence first, so start early.

Guests travelling under the Visa Waiver Program each apply for their own ESTA, so send the reminder with your save-the-dates.

A Wedded Advisor is your single point of contact from start to finish. Send us a message to start the conversation. Full guide at the link in our bio.
